title: Uniform proper lower-tail bound for the full continuous algebraic-closure coefficient
statement: Fix the same standing separated finite-type positive-characteristic field setting and a proper k-morphism p:X to Y. For the coefficient C(-,PadicAlgCl ell), there is a natural number c independent of q and K such that for every integer q and every K in Loc(Dctf(X)), Rp_*(tau_{<q-c} K) has cohomology in degrees at most q-1. This is a uniform truncation-tail estimate, with no assertion of constructibility of the proper image or coproduct comparison.

source.place: Arbitrary-complex lower-tail assertion; the heart-bound proof supplies the dimension bound, torsion reduction and Milnor sequence.

proof.text: Use Y itself as the qcqs base: quasi-compactness of its structural morphism over Spec k gives CompactSpace Y, and separatedness gives QuasiSeparatedSpace Y. The identity Y to Y is proper. The actual full continuous-map coefficient is the sixth case of IsLocalizingAdmissibleCoefficient, witnessed by the identity monoid-object isomorphism. Apply exists_uniform_lowerTail_bound_of_isProper to this coefficient, the identity on Y, and p. It gives c in N, independent of the cutoff and K, with H^r(Rp_* tau_{<=a-1} K)=0 whenever a+c<=r, for exactly the localizingClosureProEtale of the statement.

Set a=q-c. For every r>q-1, integral arithmetic gives a+c<=r. DerivedCategory.isLE_iff therefore puts Rp_* tau_{<=a-1} K in degrees <=q-1. The standard t-structure isomorphism truncLEIsoTruncLT (a-1) a identifies this truncation with tau_{<a} K. Map that isomorphism by the actual total derived pushforward and transport the upper bound with isLE_of_iso. moduleObjectDerivedPushforward is definitionally the rightDerivedFunctor of lowerStar, so this is the stated conclusion. There is no boundedness or completeness assumption on K; empty schemes, zero K, negative cutoffs, and c=0 are included.

proof_origin.place: Lower-tail assertion, specialized from the existing general qcqs proper hull-tail theorem; F5 Lean proof, 2026-10-24. The general theorem supplies the heart-to-unbounded-tail argument for the actual full continuous coefficient.

theorem continuousAlgCl_proper_lowerTail
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ℓ)]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (p : X ⟶ Y) [p.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] [IsProper p] :
    ∃ c : ℕ, ∀ (q : ℤ)
      (K : DerivedCategory (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
        (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj (PadicAlgCl ℓ)) X))),
      localizingClosureProEtale (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj (PadicAlgCl ℓ)) X K →
      ((lowerStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj (PadicAlgCl ℓ)) p).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
        ((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncLT (q - (c : ℤ))).obj K)).IsLE (q - 1)
